Cookie Policy

privacy choices.

This policy explains the limited browser storage used on the website and how to change your preference.

Effective: 8 September 2026No advertising tracking
On this pageWhat this meansWhat we useOptional technologiesHow to control it

1. Cookies and similar technologies

Cookies are small files placed on a device by a website. Similar technologies include local browser storage. This website currently uses local storage to remember your privacy choice. The preference remains on your device unless it expires or you clear it.

2. Storage currently used

skyway-consent-v1

  • Provider: Skyway Lubricants
  • Purpose: remembers whether you chose necessary-only or allowed optional technologies, preventing the notice from appearing on every visit;
  • Type: necessary local browser storage;
  • Duration: up to 12 months, subject to your browser settings.

This necessary preference does not identify you by name and is not used for advertising, behavioural profiling or cross-site tracking.

3. Optional analytics and marketing

Skyway does not currently use analytics or advertising cookies on this website. Selecting “Allow optional cookies” records your preference but does not activate any such service unless the website is later updated. Before optional technologies are introduced, this policy and the consent controls must be updated so that those technologies are not activated without the applicable choice.

The website uses hosting infrastructure and externally hosted typefaces. Those services may receive ordinary technical request information such as IP address and browser information when resources are delivered; Skyway does not use those requests for its own advertising tracking.

4. Change or withdraw your choice

Select to review your choice. You can also delete local storage or cookies through your browser. Blocking necessary storage may cause the notice to reappear but should not prevent access to the main content.

5. Contact

Questions may be sent to ludidil@skywayservices.co.za. For more information about personal-information handling, read the Privacy & POPIA Notice.
